title: Toolchain check document
description: One toolchain, as `recon toolchain check` resolves it on this machine: the same object `recon verify` puts in toolchains[].

root.description: Empty when the toolchain has no install root: its tools are looked up on PATH.

cc.description: The compiler, as it was resolved — including the case where it was found on PATH.

files_checked.description: How many of the profile's [install] files were hashed. Zero when there is no root to hash against.
